facebook.caption:
Locals don't post about Bãi Dài. That's the point.

While the crowds pile onto the southern beaches, this stretch stays quiet. Long, wide, and mostly empty on a weekday. No beach clubs fighting for your attention. Just sand, water, and room to breathe.

If your Phu Quoc itinerary starts and ends at Bãi Trường, you're missing this.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walking Bãi Dài at low tide. Barely anyone in frame. This is still possible in Phu Quoc, you just have to know where to go.
